prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: STL decomposition reveals consistent downward trend across both folds with moderate seasonal amplitude. ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while CWT_rf best captures seasonality (0.252 correlation). FT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (132.08) but extreme model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=78.37) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking with mixed weighting to exploit decomposition structure while handling drift dynamically.
